_comment: AUTHORITATIVE program-corpus inventory — generated from the filesystem by programs/gen_program_inventory.py. Do NOT hand-edit. Every stated program count in this repo must be read from `counts` here, never hand-typed; `--check` fails when a doc quotes a different number.

definitions.programs_py: `.py` files directly in `plugins/vibe-ic/programs/` (non-recursive). The programs themselves: tests, sub-packages and helpers under `programs/tests/`, `programs/gds_antenna/`, `programs/metal_fill/` are NOT included.
definitions.programs_catalogued: Rows in `programs/INDEX.md` — `programs_py` minus private helpers (`_name.py`), `DEPRECATED_*` / `*_shim.py`, deprecation shims, and any file that does not parse. Always <= `programs_py`.
definitions.programs_py_all: Every `.py` anywhere under `plugins/vibe-ic/programs/`, recursively. This is `programs_py` + `program_tests_all` + the sub-package modules, and it is NOT a count of programs — quoting it as one is the ambiguity this file exists to remove.
definitions.program_tests: `test_*.py` under `plugins/vibe-ic/programs/tests/`, recursively. The pytest node files; helper modules under `tests/` are excluded.
definitions.program_tests_all: Every `.py` under `plugins/vibe-ic/programs/tests/`, recursively — `program_tests` plus the shared helpers and fixtures those tests import.
definitions.checkers_check_py: `programs/*_check.py` — the checker subset of `programs_py` under the narrow `_check.py` naming convention.
definitions.checkers_check_audit_lint: `programs/*_check.py` + `*_audit.py` + `*_lint.py` — the wider checker subset. This is the number a '~600 checkers' claim is about; it is NOT a correction of `programs_py`, it is a different population.
definitions.skill_compliance_tests: `test_*.py` under `plugins/vibe-ic/skills/*/tests/` — the per-skill compliance regressions. Counted separately from `program_tests`; a bare `pytest` from the plugin root collects `programs/tests/` only.
